items.title: CFC and Carrick Group announce executive appointments
items.summary: Specialist insurer CFC and Bermuda legacy insurer Carrick Group have announced executive appointments across their people, operations and commercial leadership teams.

items.title: Optio and Taurus buy into Europe in specialty expansion push
items.summary: Optio Group has acquired Norwegian aquaculture MGA SAFE Forsikring, while Gibraltar-based Taurus Insurance Services has taken over Status Insurance Management.

items.title: Actuaries warn ocean risks are a blind spot for insurers
items.summary: A new report from the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries warns that ocean degradation represents a systemic risk that is largely overlooked in conventional financial assessments.

items.title: Most UK brokers lack formal AI strategy despite widespread staff usage, survey shows
items.summary: Insurance Business UK published an article by Moterra examining how broking offices use unapproved public artificial intelligence tools and the resulting compliance questions under existing regulatory frameworks.
